beats.vo: In June 2025, an ad aired during the NBA Finals.
beats.head: AN AD AIRED IN THE [g]NBA FINALS[/g]

beats.vo: It took about two days to make, and under two thousand dollars in AI costs.
beats.head: [g]2 DAYS.[/g] UNDER [g]$2,000.[/g]

beats.vo: No studio. No actors. No film crew.
beats.head: No studio. No [r]crew.[/r]

beats.vo: A normal TV ad can take months, and hundreds of thousands of dollars.
beats.head: Normally: [r]MONTHS.[/r]

beats.vo: So, is the ad agency dead?
beats.head: So, is the agency [o]dead?[/o]

beats.vo: To answer that, look at how an ad actually gets made.
beats.head: How an ad [c]really[/c] gets made

beats.vo: Every ad goes through a chain.
beats.head: Every ad goes through a [c]CHAIN[/c]

beats.vo: Start with the shoot. This is generative video.
beats.head: This is [c]generative video.[/c]

beats.vo: Instead of booking a set, you describe the shot, and a model renders it.
beats.head: Describe it. [g]Render it.[/g]

beats.vo: For that NBA ad, the creator ran three to four hundred generations, to keep just fifteen clips.
beats.head: [g]300–400[/g] tries. [g]15[/g] keepers.

beats.vo: Next, versions. This is dynamic creative.
beats.head: This is [c]dynamic creative.[/c]

beats.vo: One ad becomes hundreds: a new headline, colour, or language for every audience.
beats.head: 1 ad → [g]HUNDREDS[/g]

beats.vo: Then, targeting and bidding. This is the ad auction.
beats.head: This is the [c]ad auction.[/c]

beats.vo: Every time you open an app, advertisers bid for your screen, in about a tenth of a second.
beats.head: [g]~100 ms.[/g] Every scroll.

beats.vo: Then, a big problem.
beats.head: Then, a [r]BIG[/r] problem

beats.vo: When Coca-Cola made its holiday ads with AI, people noticed. And many did not like it.
beats.head: People [r]noticed.[/r]

beats.vo: Because AI does not remove the work. It moves it.
beats.head: AI doesn't remove work. It [c]moves[/c] it.

beats.vo: Their twenty twenty-five ad needed five AI specialists, sorting through seventy thousand clips, in about thirty days.
beats.head: [g]70,000[/g] clips. [g]5[/g] people. [g]30[/g] days.

beats.vo: So, is the agency dead? No. But the job has changed.
beats.head: Agency dead? [c]No.[/c] The job changed.

beats.vo: Machines now do the making. Humans do the taste: the idea, the judgment, the final call.
beats.head: Machines make. [g]Humans decide.[/g]

beats.vo: And the people who learn both will run the next decade of advertising.
beats.head: Learn [g]both.[/g]

beats.vo: Join AI and Advertising, by IdeaBro Studio. Link in bio.
beats.head: Join [g]AI & Advertising[/g]
